IS 16415 : 2015 : Composite Cement - SpecificationICS 91.100.10CED 2Reaffirmed 20201. SCOPEThis standard covers the manufacture, and chemical and physical requirements of composite cement.2 REFERENCESThis standard given in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
